name: What preparation is needed before interior painters start working?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before interior painters start working?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before interior painters begin, it's helpful to clear the room of furniture and valuables. If you can't move larger items, we can assist with carefully shifting them and covering them. We handle all surface preparation, including cleaning walls, filling small holes, patching cracks, and sanding. Proper preparation ensures a smooth, lasting finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before painting, clear rooms of small items; we handle moving larger furniture and all surface preparation like cleaning and patching.
